title: Capacitor vs. inductor
idea: Both store energy. A capacitor stores it in an electric field, an inductor in a magnetic field.

rows: Conductive surfaces with an insulator between

cards.t: Stores energy in an electric field
Stores energy in a magnetic field
Conductive surfaces separated by an insulator
cards.why: Plates with an insulator between them make a capacitor.
A coil of wire is an inductor.

cards.t: Combined with an inductor to make a resonant circuit
cards.why: An inductor plus a capacitor makes a resonant circuit.

compare.how: An inductor and a capacitor make a resonant (tuned) circuit.

traps.why: Inductance is the magnetic one. An electric field is capacitance.
Capacitance is the electric one. A magnetic field is inductance.
An inductor stores energy in a magnetic field, not an electric one.
A capacitor is plates and an insulator. A coil of wire is an inductor.
A resonant circuit needs both kinds of storage: an inductor and a capacitor.
